name: CANDESARTAN/HYDROCHLOROTHIAZIDE 16/12.5MG 28 TABLETS (ABBOTT)
description: Hydrochlorothiazide is used to treat edema (fluid retention; excess fluid retained in body tissues) caused by various medical problems, including heart, kidney, and liver disease, and to treat edema caused by the use of certain medications. It requires a prescription. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
